description: Variant binder of type &String returned from a String-returning function compiles via the implicit ref-to-value coercion (Copy / ConstShare T are allowed at owned destinations, including return position). The runtime path exercises the None arm; the Some arm exists only to pin the compile-time shape that previously rejected. Negative coverage (non-Copy non-ConstShare types still rejected) lives in lang/tests/driver/test_ref_to_value_extended_slots.py::test_return_negative_destructible_still_rejected.
